title: RETRACE — Outrun Your Past · one-hand arcade game for iPhone
meta_description: A one-hand endless arcade game for iPhone. Every room you clear comes back as an echo of your own run. Offline, no story, no end. The only enemy is your past.
og_description: Every room you clear comes back as an echo of your own run. One hand. Endless. Offline.
jsonld_description: A one-hand endless arcade game. Every room you clear comes back as an echo of your own run.
whisper_1: every move you make is remembered
whisper_2: and it's coming back for you
hook: Every room you clear comes back as an echo of your own run.
about: RETRACE is a one-hand endless arcade game for iPhone and iPad. Press to go, drag to bend, reach the gate at the top. Every room you clear comes back as an echo of your own run, so ten rounds in the room is full of your past. No story, no enemy, no level design: every threat is something you did. Offline, free, playable on mute. A meditation with a fail state.
store_label: Download RETRACE on the App Store
support_description: Contact RETRACE support and answers to common questions
support_intro: Need help with RETRACE? Write to us and we'll get back to you
support_details: Tell us which iPhone you use and the version shown at the bottom of the game's settings
support_a_death: Your run ends the moment your dot touches an echo's dot. Echo trails never hurt you, only the moving dots do. The band at the bottom is the safe zone: nothing can catch you inside it, and an echo inside it can't catch anyone either.
support_a_powerups: In a free run a token sometimes appears in the room. Touch it and clear the room to keep its power-up; it waits in the corner until you tap it to use it on the next room. You hold one at a time, and a new one replaces the old. Immunity survives every touch, Flash outpaces every echo for a room, Big safe zone makes the safe zone twice as tall, Wide gate opens the whole top edge, and Pick start lets you choose where you begin. Every fourth room you can also get one by watching a short ad.
support_q_reminders: How do I turn reminders off?
support_a_reminders: Open Settings from the gear on the title screen and turn off Notifications, or turn them off in iOS Settings → Notifications → RETRACE. The game sends at most one reminder a day, at 19:00, and only on a day you didn't play.
support_languages: RETRACE plays in your iPhone's language when it speaks it, and in English otherwise.
privacy_local: Your best score and your settings. There is no account, and we never ask for your name, email, contacts, photos or location.
privacy_analytics_html: The game sends anonymous gameplay events (sessions, the round a run ended, ads watched) to GameAnalytics under a random id made on your phone. Its SDK adds your device model, iOS version and the vendor identifier, plus the advertising identifier only if you allow tracking.
privacy_ads_html: Ads are served by Google AdMob and only play when you choose to watch one. Where required by law you are asked for consent first, and iOS asks before any tracking. You can change your choice any time in the game's settings or in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking.
privacy_notifications: Reminders, if you turn them on, are created on your phone. Nothing is sent to a server.
privacy_children: The game is not directed at children under 13.
